QrScan.label: Scans de QR Codes
QrScan.schema: CREATE TABLE qr_scans (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, poi_id INT, scanned_at DATETIME, ip_address VARCHAR(45), user_agent TEXT, referer TEXT)

QrStyle.label: Styles de QR Codes
QrStyle.schema: CREATE TABLE qr_styles (poi_id INT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT, color VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT '000000', bgcolor VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'FFFFFF', size INT DEFAULT 300, format VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'png', qzone INT DEFAULT 1, logo_path TEXT, created_at DATETIME, updated_at DATETIME)
